status: simulator specified and implemented; no eligible pilot input, power result, or selected seed count exists

continuousWorkingModel.mean: the prospectively frozen alternative for the component
continuousWorkingModel.dispersion: the component's one-sided 95 percent upper SD from an eligible blinded pilot
continuousWorkingModel.test: one-sided Student t at alpha 0.05/9 using simulated Normal mean and chi-square sample-variance sufficient statistics
continuousWorkingModel.generator: Box-Muller standard Normal and Marsaglia-Tsang gamma draws from domain-separated SeededPrng streams

binaryWorkingModel.simulation: calculate the exact probability of crossing the critical success count and draw one decision indicator per repetition

streamRule: Derive a separate deterministic stream from the registered root seed for every candidate, member, and component. Candidate or component ordering cannot share or shift random draws.
selectionAuthority: Only the fourteen component success counts may enter the dependence-robust selection rule. The joint count under independent component streams is labeled diagnostic-only and cannot authorize a smaller candidate.
distributionalLimitation: The Normal model is a prospectively declared parametric power working model aligned with the registered seed-level t tests; it is not evidence that future component outcomes are Normal. Upper pilot dispersion and component-union selection address variance and unidentified dependence, not arbitrary distributional misspecification. Final reporting must state this limitation and include registered robustness analyses where the study protocol requires them.
zeroDispersionRule: A zero upper SD is treated as a point mass and passes every repetition only when the frozen alternative is strictly in the registered direction beyond the null boundary.
failureRule: Incomplete pilot input, missing conservative dispersion, changed candidates or repetition count, an undeclared dependence model, or a non-reproducible seed blocks simulation admission. Software fixtures cannot supply a campaign power result.
qualificationRule: Software qualification must use synthetic fixtures, replay an identical seed bit-for-bit, exercise continuous and exact-binomial paths, and bind its output to the committed implementation. Qualification does not select campaign N.
claimBoundary: This specification and implementation define a prospective deterministic power simulator. They are not pilot evidence, a power result, selected sample size, resource authorization, study outcome, scientific finding, independent review, or publication result.
